author: Alex Baker
title: Foster City declares state of emergency due to ongoing cyberattack - NewsBreak
text:
By Alex Baker ,
1 days ago
( KRON ) — A cyberattack that took Foster City government services offline last week remains ongoing, according to an update from the city. The City of Foster City announced last Thursday it had been hit by a cyber security breach that was impacting city services due to ransomware on its networks.
As a result of the attack, city IT staff put all public services outside of emergency services on pause. On Monday, five days after the attack was first announced, its impacts were ongoing.
SF Hamburger Project responds to viral photo of raw hamburger left in sun In an update on Facebook, the City of Foster City said it was still investigating the attack. While the investigation is underway, the city has taken its network offline.
(Getty Images) This has disrupted phone and email systems leaving city staff unable to make or receive phone calls or respond to emails, the city said.
“If you contact us, staff will respond when services are available,” the city said on Facebook.
Emergency services including 911 remain up and running with first responders still available to assist the city said. Foster City City Hall also remains open to the public with limited services.
At a special meeting Monday night, the Foster City City Council declared a state of emergency in relation to the ongoing attack.
